Just terrible
Jul 2019 • Couples
I don't understand how this restaurant has such high reviews. The food is terrible and bland at worst and mediocre at best. I ordered the pita falafel and my boyfriend ordered the black bean zucchini burger. We were so excited for our food. The falafel came and it was... Ok. After the server gave me my plate she then turned to my partner and said oh we don't have any black bean burgers.... She waited until after my food came to tell us that?? So he ordered the mushroom sandwich instead which was supposed to be "marinated in garlic and thyme" and come with a "tangy chickpea sauce". Yea absolutely not. Clearly they microwaved everything. They had a happy hour special with one free juice when you order a burger or pizza. We asked about it but they said we couldn't get it because we didn't get a burger... We ordered a burger and 20 minutes later were told that there weren't any burgers... this was a chance for redemption. But they utterly failed. So, in total we got a mediocre falafel, a terribly bland mushroom sandwich, and bad service for 230 k dong (terribly overpriced). Anyways, I hope I can warn people about this restaurant to avoid a disappointing meal. Spend your money somewhere else. It will get you MUCH better food.

Written July 1, 2019
Huong Mai
Dear Customer,
We are very sorry to hear about your bad experience with us yesterday, and thank you for giving us the chance to know what happened. Our staff only found out the blackbean cake went wrong before serving you, thus we had to cancel it to you that late. Due to language problem, our staff were not able to solve the issues for the sake of the customers, which we always strive for. We would be willing to refund you for this unsatisfied service, please contact us to get your refund, or if you can kindly come back for another meal, we would be delighted to offer you our best food that have always been enjoyed by our customers and hope that you will change your opinions on the 2nd chance.
Thank you for your kind co-operation.
Kind Regards
